item.title: Special Issue Proposals
item.content:encoded:
The Journal of Consumer Behaviour invites researchers to propose new special issues through a formal submission process. Proposals should follow specific guidelines and procedures outlined in the journal's template and application form.

Potential guest editors must submit their special issue proposals within a designated application window. The journal will consider proposals for special issues planned for 2026 and 2027, with submissions evaluated according to established criteria.

Appel publié par Journal of Consumer Behaviour. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Timeline

  • August 1, 2025: Special Issue Proposal application window opens
  • August 15, 2025: Special Issue Proposal application window closes; deadline for Special Issue Proposals for 2026/2027
